label: FP
reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) is a False Positive. Although the sink expression `response.sendRedirect("https://" + host + "/" + seg)` incorporates user input, the `host` variable is strictly validated using a regex `^[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+\.safe\.com$` (Lines 18-19) before the redirect occurs. This ensures the redirect authority (domain) is always confined to the trusted `.safe.com` namespace. The user-controlled `seg` parameter only affects the path segment, which cannot alter the destination domain to perform an open redirect to an external site. The resolved sink value is therefore semantically safe regarding redirect integrity.

evidence.note: Regex validation on host variable restricts redirect authority to .safe.com, mitigating open redirect risk despite user-controlled path segment.
